lines.text: Hello, little coder! Today you will tell a cat where to go — with arrows!
Each arrow block moves the cat.
One arrow block moves one square.
Put blocks in a row to make a script.
The cat does them in order, one after another.
Press Run to watch the cat follow your blocks.
Help the cat get to the star.
Three right arrows — the cat got the star!
Great work! Let’s remember what we learned.
Now build along, then try the challenges. You’ve got this!
